findings.summary: Arrow Down does not continue from VoiceOver cursor position in Safari (Select)
Uncontrolled Select root ignores form reset
Hidden form input blocks implicit submission without a submit button
No consistent item focus-visible state for Select
Highlighted SelectItem contrast 1.09:1 light / 1.18:1 dark in base styles
Select popup horizontally misaligned across base styles

Label -> GroupLabel; Viewport -> List; ScrollUp/DownButton -> ScrollUp/DownArrow
onValueChange value is string|null (consumer casts still typecheck)
notes: Only 1280x900 compared; resize_window to 390x844 did not change the viewport (page stayed 1280 wide), so mobile was NOT checked. Changes reverted; typecheck passed with the swap before reverting.
reasonNotMoved: Base UI Select (shadcn base-nova) is visibly different: the closed trigger shows the raw value ('apple') instead of the item label ('Apple'), the popup sits ~1px off, and ArrowDown can highlight disabled items where Radix skips them. Safety: open Base UI issue on VoiceOver navigation (https://github.com/mui/base-ui/issues/5934) and open shadcn base-style issues (https://github.com/shadcn-ui/ui/issues/12520, https://github.com/shadcn-ui/ui/issues/10543). Retry after adding label mapping (items prop on Root or SelectValue render function in consumers and the gallery demo), matching disabled-item behaviour, and re-verifying Escape/focus return and the 390x844 viewport.
